name: Twelve-State Critical-Pendant Obstruction
definition: Use the chain-and-punctured-fiber construction with $d=4$, $j=3$, and $\epsilon=0$: the base on $\{a,b_1,b_2,b_3\}$ contains all prefixes of $b_1b_2b_3$ and every $a$-state except $\{a,b_3\}$, and a new coordinate is attached above the base with the lone lower state $\{a\}$.
properties: It has $2^3+4=12$ states on five active coordinates and is contraction-minimal nonlearning. All five one-coordinate contractions are learning-space graphs, but none of its ten one-coordinate links is simultaneously antipodal and nonlearning. It is the sharpness witness for eleven-state contraction descent and refutes antipodal link descent even for a semicube of a learning-space graph.
